title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
PRINCIPAL DATA ENGINEER

UP TO £110,000 + BENEFITS

LONDON (HYBRID)

Join a business undergoing a major data transformation programme, investing heavily in cloud technologies, modern data platforms, and engineering excellence.

THE COMPANY

Our client is a large, globally recognised organisation investing significantly in its data and analytics capabilities.

This role sits within a growing data function and offers the opportunity to influence strategy, architecture, and engineering standards while working on business-critical data initiatives.

THE ROLE

As Principal Data Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across multiple data engineering initiatives, helping to define best practice while remaining hands-on with architecture and delivery.

  • Leading the design, build, and deployment of scalable, cloud-based data platforms and pipelines.
  • Driving engineering excellence across data processing, automation, testing, monitoring, and DevOps practices.
  • Mentoring and coaching senior engineers while helping to shape the wider engineering function.
  • Leading operational improvements, service reviews, and performance optimisation initiatives.

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Strong SQL development expertise.
  • Extensive experience building data platforms and pipelines within cloud environments.
  • Experience with technologies such as Snowflake, AWS, dbt, or similar cloud-native platforms.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data management, governance, and security principles.

SALARY AND BENEFITS

  • Up to £110,000
  • Pension scheme
  • Hybrid working model
  • Clear progression and leadership opportunities

HOW TO APPLY

Please register your interest by sending your CV to Ross McEwan through the Apply link.
